verification_vs_validation: Verification proves each bounded contract; validation exercises expected operator/agent mission sequences on the declared target and checks that the artifacts support the intended decisions. Neither substitutes for the other.
campaign_order: C0: pin host/implementation/contract sources and build an exact invocation manifest; all unresolved production bindings remain blocked.
C1: tracer-first direct/MCP authority parity and one upstream/downstream handoff; inject known bad outcomes to qualify each oracle.
C2: custody/continuity tracer, including revoke-interrupt-restart-reconcile, delayed request races, and outcome uncertainty.
C3: lane-specific functional witnesses using existing kernels and reference parity; numerical experiments only under MR model profile.
C4: unit, negative, integration, API/boundary, semantic/structural, temporal-drift, and mutation families.
C5: edge-specific causal families and pressure sequences; retain alternate-path observations.
C6: speed/resource/recovery benchmarks and E2E operator/agent workflows on exact target.
C7: cumulative regression, public/private package inspection, independent assurance, and exact-build human acceptance packet.

test_families.unit: Pure transformations and decisions at smallest bounded seam.
test_families.negative: Absent/invalid/stale/contradictory inputs with zero forbidden effect.
test_families.mutation: Delete gate invocation, weaken threshold, swap identity, omit proof, invert predicate, suppress failure; record operator and killed/surviving evidence. Critical survivor blocks.
test_families.integration: Real adjacent canonical components with one authority/store and observed seam behavior.
test_families.behavioral: Ordered sequences S01-S16 with cut points; compare states, rights, effects, and receipts, not only final return.
test_families.API: Direct versus MCP parity, schemas, auth, error mapping, transport interruption, and bounded bodies.
test_families.semantic_structural: Declared semantic delta and unchanged-invariant parity; exact LOC bands plus inherited complexity gates.
test_families.boundary: One below, equal, one above bounds; zero/empty/large input; exact expiry and race ordering.
test_families.temporal_authorization_drift: Revoke/rotate/expire/change epoch between lookup, admission, reservation, dispatch, commit, and receipt.
test_families.causal_edge_deletion: Each named edge has intact, deletion, restoration, matched/sham, alternate-on and alternate-off arms; record physical realizability and confounders.
test_families.speed: Pinned workload/host, warmup, all raw timings including failures, fixed percentile calculation, and resource peaks.
test_families.E2E: Human/agent intake through lawful handoffs, completion/recovery, and exact-artifact review; real required witnesses, no substitution with fixtures.

candidate_space.dimensions: 58 invariant requirements x 14 mechanisms x 13 owning gates = 10556
candidate_space.preservation: Every tuple is materialized, exported, and hashed. P_GATE_OWNER and P_MECHANISM explain exclusions. Eligibility mapping is an explicit design assumption reviewed at P0, not experimental proof of irrelevance.
candidate_space.cross_cutting: Authority/egress/custody gates apply to every operation through F01-F04/F18/F20 and B01-B09. Owning-gate exclusion avoids duplicate assertion ownership; it does not exempt an operation from cross-cutting controls.
candidate_space.sequence_overlay: S01-S16 cover pressure/cut-point behavior separately. Do not multiply every axis blindly. A new causal interaction adds versioned dimensions/cases or a separately complete campaign with a justified boundary.
candidate_space.not_claimed: The finite product is not all possible program executions; pairwise or sampled campaigns cannot replace its ledger.

supersession: An append-only relation binds old/new test identities, same requirement revision, fault mechanism, boundary set, original failure, repair observation, and decision. A changed contract requires successor requirement and explicit approval; old failure remains historically true.
execution_evidence: Record raw observations, provenance, authenticated producer, target/source/policy/schema hashes, environment, UTC and monotonic timing, assertion ID, candidate ID, run ID, and disposition. Hashes alone prove neither producer authenticity nor correctness.
causal_reporting: State observed vs inferred vs unknown. Failure of edge deletion to change output under redundancy is not evidence that the edge is irrelevant.
cumulative_regression: After each completed work item rerun all previously passing required gates in the cumulative ledger against the current candidate; cache reuse alone does not satisfy the governing policy. Gate executions are not new unique requirements.
dual_runners: The design requires pytest and unittest entrypoints to account for the declared cases. Current executed runner scope is reported in evidence, with shared assertions/fixtures not constituting independent implementation evidence; independent numerical/reference checks remain separate.
current_harness_scope: Repository-owned host, custody, voice, and verification tests execute the explicitly declared derivative scenarios. The complete 189-case candidate ledger retains NOT_EXECUTED until each requirement-specific observer/oracle is bound. No generic 189-case target runner is supplied or claimed; an empty collection or missing runner is not TARGET_HARNESS_UNBOUND evidence. Historical planning-prototype runner records are scoped to that earlier artifact, not this repository.
anti_suppression: Inspect AST/config plus runtime collection/results. Fail on skip/xfail equivalents, missing declared cases, empty suites, nonzero ignored exits, missing required command, or silent deselection. Static named checks are bounded; dynamic bypass mutation is required at target integration.
acceptance: All applicable required witnesses current and passing, critical mutants killed, required branch coverage >=90%, no pending contradiction or unresolved external effect in accepted scope, no forbidden export, and human closeout. NOT_APPLICABLE rows are not PASS and are excluded only with their explicit predicate.
failure_disposition: Test outcomes PASS/FAIL/NOT_EXECUTED/NOT_APPLICABLE remain distinct from operation state, task state, and the five mission-assurance dispositions. A failed gate blocks affected promotion; prior passes never erase a blocker.
voice_campaign: Corpus >=100 utterances: negation, units/numbers, acronyms/identifiers, self-correction, focus transfer, repeated paste, late transcription, unsupported client, cloud/context policy, screen-reader navigation, and revoke-interrupt-restart-reconcile. Report WER and critical semantic errors separately; raw accuracy is measured, accepted-command fidelity is required.
